description: Take a screenshot of a URL and return it as an inline image. Requires the Chrome for Testing browser to be downloaded (available from Cruma's Settings → AI Assistant). Useful for visually inspecting local sites, checking how a page looks, or verifying a deploy.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after page load before capturing (0–30). Default: 3.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page. Default: false.

mobile.description: Emulate a mobile device. Default: false.

name: screenshot_url
